== English Special Edition comparison ==
The [[:File:SE-L-benkenobi-decipher-archive.gif|Printed Special Edition card face]] uses “one character.” The photographed [[Ben Kenobi (Reflections Foil)|Reflections foil]] shows “your character” by 12 January 2000. Decipher’s January 2002 replacement uses that wording and allows the trigger after a battle just ended. The 14 December 2015 PC announcement specifies that the battle ended “here.” The June 2017 slip and 2023 Appendix carry that wording. The remaining game text and printed attributes match.

Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=2 Glossary Supplement], 29 January 2002, PDF page 2. Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=18 Decipher Errata], text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 18. Players Committee, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=992103#p992103 errata announcement], 14 December 2015. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=17 Decipher Errata], June 2017, PDF page 17. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=104 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 104.
